actions.title: Publish the Ruzafa listing at 329,000
actions.summary: Live on the portal this month

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: Thanks for making the time, David. The Ruzafa flat — you still want it on the market this month?

transcript.speaker: DAVID
transcript.text: That's the idea. I fly back to Bristol on the 2nd and I'd rather have it live before I go.

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: Then I'll send you the listing agreement today, so you can read it properly. Three percent plus VAT, ninety days exclusive, as we said.

transcript.speaker: DAVID
transcript.text: That's the one. And the asking price?

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: Let's say around 329,000. But I want to check the last two sales on that street before I put a number in writing.

transcript.speaker: DAVID
transcript.text: Fine. But nothing goes public below 320.

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: Nothing goes on the portal until you've seen the valuation. You have my word.

transcript.speaker: DAVID
transcript.text: One more thing — the storage room downstairs isn't in the sale. My son keeps his bike there.

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: I'll put that on the file. Furniture?

transcript.speaker: CLARA
transcript.text: Right. Let's talk Thursday at noon and I'll have the comparables by then.

transcript.speaker: DAVID
transcript.text: Thursday at twelve. Works for me.
